title: Gongting Blind Matching Service
role: Shared UI design and owned all screen publishing
introduction: A blind-matching service for Tech University of Korea students. I built introduction, signup, profile, matching, and result screens based on personality and interests, then deployed the site to GitHub Pages.
myWorks: Structured intro, user, and match flows as static pages under `html/` with `intro.html` as the entry
Set a mobile-first UI direction and organized brand tone, graphics, SCSS, and JS under `resources/`
Split UI component samples into `component.html` for reusable screen-level publishing
Deployed to GitHub Pages (`yheun03.github.io/gongting`) with favicon and asset sets
achievements: Documented early service participation: 171 users in the first round and 121 in the second
Version-controlled screens and assets on GitHub, separate from the portfolio archive copy
points: Follow-up planning based on participation and feedback
duration: ~1 week build / ~2 months operation and enhancement
